name: labs/jovanmarkov96__keysight-dsox1200-control
title: Keysight InfiniiVision 1200 X-Series oscilloscope (keysight_dsox1200.DSOX1200)
intro: Keysight InfiniiVision 1200 X-Series oscilloscope (keysight_dsox1200.DSOX1200), adapted from jovanmarkov96/keysight-dsox1200-control. It reads `identity`, `channel1_probe_ratio`, `channel1_invert`, `timebase_mode` and 7 more; sets `channel1_display`, `channel1_coupling`, `channel1_scale_v_per_div`, `channel1_offset_v` and 4 more; runs `measure`, `run`, `single`, `autoscale` and 1 more. `measure`: read one scalar automatic measurement from the scope's current measurement source. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
